manual_review_areas.basis: Manually read all method bodies: foreign parent/UID/boot/birth, duplicate PID, fresh product checks, missing/partial ARM/ACK, fdinfo/close, raw wait, coherent SIGTERM forgery, signal count, reset/reverse/order/deadline, strict JSON, negative facts, output drift and consumed attempts.

Two source methods invoke real compile/link/runtime for separate fresh normal/loss cases, require concrete owned wait/signal/close outcomes and fail on Linux prerequisites. Their source presence supplies no executed result.

No-follow bounded descriptor capture verifies exact utility hashes, rejects positive cached names and executes distinct non-main module bodies. CPython/stdlib and previously reviewed immutable utilities are trusted, not sandboxed.

Unchanged four-command object utility, one fresh link/product with actual ELF PT_INTERP and descriptive LOAD inventory, one fixed runtime. Boundary bytes/identity checks do not authenticate all compiler/linker inputs while executing.

Symbolic system-header SYS constants, explicit long/unsigned-long/null operands and representability guards; no invented number or provider filename. Runtime capability remains unknown until Linux execution.
Controller opens before guard; owned guard pidfd before GUARD_START; guard-created one fixed worker with no exec/descendants. Coordinator does not claim independently observed worker fork return.
Private nonce/case/magic/role packets bounded by PIPE_BUF; guard checks anchored controller throughout setup/progress and arms/ACKs before allowed controller command.
Guard sees controller exit then commands worker quit, pidfd-observes worker and only guard reaps it; coordinator reaps its two direct children.
Deliberate controller exit23 after ACK, guard current identity/product/time then one anchored worker SIGKILL, pidfd event and matching own waitpid SIGKILL; no signal retry.

Managed pidfds close at most once with immediate EBADF; worker inherited controller copy has a separate ledger. Guard closed stdio before private pipe creation, worker preserves reused pipe numbers; ledger role+fd uniqueness does not authenticate all descriptors.
Inherited +5/+8/+10/+12/+14 epoch and overflow headroom; bad/reverse marks gate work. Stage polling/read/write/wait uses repeated monotonic checks rather than budget resets.

First error retained; guard signals only owned anchored worker after self/worker/product/time, coordinator only anchored controller/guard after child/product/time. Async or setup without acquired anchors can retain unknown cleanup.

Recomputes exact typed shapes, trusted signal/poll/errno constants, owned topology, actual raw status, complete packet chain, anchored polls, one-close EBADF, case signal ledger and absolute event order.

Typed handled negatives may retain unknown facts without requiring positive proof; they cannot produce narrow positive flags or authority. This is retained failure evidence, not cleanup-success certification.

Fresh output and marker absence, exclusive marker before compile, exact raw request/host/bootstrap binding and source/marker/self/output checks precompile/preruntime/postruntime. Failed consumption is permanent.
Execute refuses before parser/utilities/request/compiler. No scientific/native import or mutation, OS shim, model/Torch/GPU/queue or external PID/executable route.

Four C roles exclude observer/compiler; direct-child backend cleanup excludes compiler descendants; whole-tree/controller/guard/observer/host loss, mapped-code, physical exclusion, resource rights and model ABI remain unproved.

The three captured utility hashes are rechecked and no old implementation is modified by the new four source paths. Broad historical scientific/native/data preservation is separately owned evidence; it was not repeated here and no dataset was parsed.

All five retained preliminary findings and root-authored earlyalive/overflow checks were manually traced in the selected latest Python/C source. Original mutable source is not reconstructed as raw evidence.
